svg.title: Equal-footing compound / בהשואה אחת
svg.desc: Chapter 3, Hebrew p33, English p34. Two equal circles sit at the same height inside the established violet compound bracket. The predications are presented on equal footing. Equal size does not mean synonymous content, numerical equality, equal probability, or equal certainty. Two units illustrate plurality without restricting the source to exactly two. The bracket groups coasserted content; no inference is drawn. Ramchal describes this branch without assigning it a separate formal Hebrew name.
